Title: Fragment of the Book of Nod

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Can you tap the Fragment of the Book of Nod during
a time when cards are not supposed to be replaced?
That is, during a referendum or during a turn after
you've played a Wake With Evening's Freshness?

If so, do you discard down to the number of cards you
had, or is your "hand size" still considered to be
normal?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> Can you tap the Fragment of the Book of Nod during
> a time when cards are not supposed to be replaced?
> That is, during a referendum or during a turn after
> you've played a Wake With Evening's Freshness?

Yes.

> If so, do you discard down to the number of cards you
> had, or is your "hand size" still considered to be
> normal?

Any cards (like Wake or cards played during a referendum)
that you are currently not replacing count against your hand
size.
